queries.sql: SELECT stock_batches.*, products.name AS product_name, products.sku AS product_sku, vendors.name AS vendor_name, COALESCE((SELECT procurement_rules.name FROM batch_procurement_rules INNER JOIN procurement_rules ON batch_procurement_rules.procurement_rule_id = procurement_rules.id WHERE batch_procurement_rules.batch_id = stock_batches.id AND batch_procurement_rules.is_active = 1 ORDER BY batch_procurement_rules.id DESC LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN stock_batches.selling_price IS NOT NULL THEN 'Own rule' ELSE NULL END) AS rule_name FROM `stock_batches` LEFT JOIN `products` ON `stock_batches`.`product_id` = `products`.`id` LEFT JOIN `vendors` ON `stock_batches`.`vendor_id` = `vendors`.`id` WHERE products.sku LIKE 'ELC-%' ORDER BY `stock_batches`.`received_at` DESC
